query:
SELECT
                    EXISTS (
                        SELECT
                            1
                        FROM
                            email_links l
                            JOIN email_imap_connection_attempts a ON a.link_id = l.id
                        WHERE
                            a.id = $1
                            AND l.macro_id = $2
                            AND l.is_sync_active
                            AND l.sync_generation = a.sync_generation
                            AND l.grant_generation = a.grant_generation) AS "current!"
